resolution.note: ADR 0021 retirement rule now states the Wald bound below margin 0.25 with z 1.2816 and cites t-76cjaca; grep -ci fisher returns 0

title: ADR 0021 records the bound-below-margin retirement rule
body:
t-76cjaca (merged 7953037) replaced the Fisher non-significance retirement rule in src/brain/retire.ts with a one-sided 90% Wald upper bound on benefit below a 0.25 margin; ADR 0021 still records the Fisher rule, so the decision record contradicts the code.
Files: docs/adr/0021-*.md
Outcome: ADR 0021 states the bound-below-margin retirement rule with z and margin and cites t-76cjaca; grep for the Fisher retirement rule in docs/adr/0021 returns 0 lines.
Proof: grep -ci 'fisher' on the ADR's retirement section returns 0 and the ADR names t-76cjaca.
